title: finding(app-shell): the Studio flow simulator's Debug run routes edges unlike the runtime's `traverseNext` — a condition-less non-default edge out of a decision is never taken, and a guarded edge out of a non-decision node is always taken
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites (class a). The Studio Debug run shows a path through a flow that the runtime would not take. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10615 dev report (PR objectui#10672, findings 1 and 2) and the contract review of that PR at `7f49154`, which confirmed both against the runtime source. The dev measured both on `FlowSimulator`, the class `FlowSimulatorPanel` drives; ⛔ the seat did not re-run them. Both are pre-existing: base gives the same answers. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The two divergences

1. **A decision out-edge with no condition and no `isDefault`.**
   - The runtime's `AutomationEngine.traverseNext` (objectstack `origin/main`) puts it in the unconditional bucket and always runs it. It also runs the default edge when no conditional edge matched.
   - The Debug run never takes it: a decision with out-edge `eu` (no condition, not default) and default `ed` visits `[s, d, def]` only.
2. **A guarded edge out of a NON-decision node.**
   - `enqueueSuccessors` fans out every out-edge of a non-decision node without reading `condition`.
   - `traverseNext` evaluates the conditional edges of ANY node.
   - Example: start, then assignment `{ n: 2 }`, then an edge guarded `n` greater than 5  to node `x`. The Debug run visits `x`; the runtime skips it.

## Sites

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/simulator/flow-simulator.ts`: `enqueueSuccessors` and the decision step's routing (the "Branch has no condition." rule). In PR objectui#10672, the guard itself is evaluated through `evalGuard`, the same CEL call as the runtime.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Make the Debug run's successor selection mirror `traverseNext` for every node kind: the unconditional bucket, the conditional bucket, and the default-when-nothing-matched rule. Keep the objectui#15429 ruling on overlapping conditions: the runtime takes every match, and the Debug run takes the first true guard today. Pin both cases above against a runtime-shaped expectation. ⛔ Serial: PR objectui#10672 edits these files; claim this after it merges.

## Dedupe

REST read of every objectui issue and PR updated since 2026-09-24T00:00Z (777 items), with titles matched against `simulator|Debug run|traverseNext`: only objectui#10615 / PR objectui#10672 (guards and interpolation) and objectui#10537 / PR objectui#10604 (assignment envelopes). The regex walk over the 1000 most recently updated items, `enqueueSuccessors|traverseNext|simulator.*unconditional`, found 0 about routing.

Dedupe words: `simulator enqueueSuccessors ignores condition` · `Debug run unconditional edge decision` · `traverseNext parity simulator`
